race.comment: DIAMOND GUST (2) only warmed late in his stable debut first-up when resuming over a trip short of his best. Keeps gun hoop Wiggins in the saddle and will appreciate stretching over further. Bold showing anticipated. ARTFUL PERSUASION (4) resumes from a short spell and steps out in new colours. Hasn't won for a long time but turned in some strong efforts last prep that would make him hard to beat in this. MISS MONEYPENNY (5) shoulders a fitness edge and doesn't need to improve much to land the winning blow this time. The low draw will give her a great look and you can expect her to be right there when they quicken. Last start winner HELL OF A BENTLEY (9) also deserves respect in this tougher assignment.
